dialogue_texts: Yukari
I just got here yesterday, so...
Yukari
How did I hear rumors about this "glohm" starting its work on Gensokyo's infrastructure?
Argh... No... Confound it! Where have they all gone?
Yukari
Who was that? Is it someone who lost something?
Yukari
Oh my! Who just bumped into me?
Oh! Sorry. Very sorry. I didn't notice you were standing in my way!
Yukari
You should be more careful next time, little one.
Yukari
If you stumble into the path of a sage and queen, you'll find yourself in unexpected destinations.
I'm trying to deliver all of the mail to Kozankyo's residents, and I've lost so much of it.
Yukari
How did this all happen?
I tend to be clumsy and often lose the things I'm trying to deliver.
I also didn't take the chance to introduce myself.
Kotori
The name's Kotori Tegami - a tengu who delivers the mail to Kozankyo's residents.
Yukari
Even if you know me through woodblock prints, you might not recognize my costume or hairstyle.
Kotori
You told me earlier that you're a queen? You don't look like Queen Marisa...
Yukari
I don't look like her because I'm Queen Yukari of the Democratic Kingdom of Gensokyo.
Yukari
Anyway, I'm afraid that I don't have the time to find your lost mail.
Yukari
There's a certain toxic rumor I need to silence before it slips through the gaps and enters Kozankyo.
Kotori
I don't know about this "toxic rumor" you're talking about.
Kotori
If it's a disease, I certainly don't want to get sick!
Yukari
It is unfortunately a disease, and it's the dirty work of the Gensokyo Socialite Order.
Kotori
I don't want to get sick at the worst time...
Kotori
I would have to halt my job in that case...
Yukari
Anyway, see ya.
Kotori
I can't, I have a crucial deadline approaching.
Kotori
Time is money... you'll see me fired without it!
